program.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
requirements.source_phrase: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk

outcomes.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.

nodes.question: Does the edited image visibly use a chalk-like medium or treatment, rather than merely showing generic blur, grain, or softened photographic detail?
nodes.criteria: pass: identifiable chalk-like marks or surface behavior are visible, beyond generic grain, blur, or softened photographic detail; fail: the image clearly lacks such chalk-like treatment; unknown: the visible evidence does not distinguish chalk-like treatment from generic filtering.
nodes.binding: Assess only visible evidence of chalk-like medium or treatment. Do not assess whether the image is a drawing or whether the conversion covers the whole scene.

nodes.question: Does substantial depicted content, including the giraffes and surrounding scene, visibly read as drawn rather than as photographic detail with softened or outlined edges?
nodes.criteria: pass: coherent drawn rendering changes forms, contours, or shading across substantial content, including the main subjects; fail: the content clearly remains photographic, with only blur, smearing, grain, or narrow outlines; unknown: visible evidence cannot reliably distinguish drawing conversion from filtering. Recognizable subject matter alone does not establish photographic rendering.
nodes.binding: Assess drawing-versus-photographic rendering only. Examine the giraffes as well as the scene; do not assess chalk medium or infer whole-image coverage from a localized treatment. Preserve uncertainty where photographic detail and drawn treatment are mixed.

nodes.question: Has the image been transformed into a drawing made from chalk?
nodes.criteria: Use only saved support observations. complete: n1 and n2 pass, and their evidence establishes both chalk-like medium and drawing conversion across the image; do not infer whole-image conversion from chalk-like texture, smearing, or sketch-like outlines alone. partial: either support provides affirmative evidence of requested progress, but complete conversion is not established; in particular, n1 pass with n2 fail or unknown is partial, not complete. absent: both supports fail and their evidence affirmatively establishes no requested transformation. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine whether any requested transformation progressed, including unresolved evidence without affirmative progress. A single failed or unknown cue does not establish absence. Do not infer visual facts beyond the supports; unrelated edits do not count.
nodes.binding: Target: the image. Reference: a drawing made from chalk. Combine the independent evidence for chalk medium and drawing form; do not inspect images or add requirements.

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. Return status, evidence, confidence (0 to 1 or null), and used_dependency_ids. You receive no reference label or optimizer feedback. Do not predict what the optimizer wants.
Support checks receive source and edited images. Inspect only the saved visual proposition and binding. When dependencies are supplied, use those ancestor observations as context and investigate the more specific proposition yourself; do not simply repeat the parent answer. Use pass/fail/unknown. A pass on a broad parent does not imply a nested check passes. Known negative evidence is usable; uncertain or missing evidence is unknown. Do not award requested completion credit to supporting facts.
The requested fulfillment readout receives NO images. Use ALL and ONLY saved support observations, the original instruction, rubric and saved composition criteria. Use complete/partial/absent/unknown. Mere texture or object presence must not silently establish whole-image conversion or a requested spatial relation. Known progress plus evidenced incompleteness may be partial; absence means no requested progress. Missing necessary evidence is unknown, never a fabricated failure or completion. Do not infer new visual facts.
used_dependency_ids must name every supplied dependency check_id exactly once in saved order (empty when none). Confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness.

The readout must not infer that finer coverage from a coarse support pass."}
